title: TaxonomyNode
description: A node in a controlled vocabulary taxonomy. Used to model hierarchical classifications (e.g. industry sectors, capability trees, technology stacks) where each node has a parent and zero or more children. Catalog: technehub-labs/dea-catalog-taxonomy.

taxonomy.description: Name of the taxonomy this node belongs to (e.g. 'industry-sectors', 'technology-stacks', 'business-functions').

parent_node.description: URN of the parent node in the same taxonomy.

child_nodes.description: URNs of child nodes in the same taxonomy.
